name: Ah!! My Roommate is a Succubus Hellbent on World Conquest!!
source:
Yumi is a normal university student looking to earn her degree in the arts. Having emigrated from Japan, she's looking to having a normal, peaceful, quiet university life. However, everything changes when she finds a demon of lust in her dorm bed!

[From [url=https://watercress.itch.io/ah-my-roommate-is-a-succubus-hellbent-on-world-conquest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由美是一名普通大学生，希望获得艺术学位。从日本移民后，她希望过上正常、平和、安静的大学生活。然而，当她在宿舍床上发现情欲恶魔时，一切都改变了！

[来自[url=https://watercress.itch.io/ah-my-roommate-is-a-succubus-hellbent-on-world-conquest]Itch.io[/url]]
